{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the change
print('After parsing revenue, first few values:', df['revenue'].head().tolist())
print('Revenue dtype:', df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print('\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):', len(qa_orders))
print('\nQA order IDs:', qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
print('\nAfter removing QA and refunded orders, shape:', completed_only.shape)"}
